title: Introducing the Future of Nike Sportswear: An Innovation Pipeline Built for What’s Next
summary: Project Ride, Nike Morpho X and the Nike Therma-FIT A.I.R. Jacket are part of broader effort to reshape the Nike Sportswear portfolio around greater newness, distinction and more meaningful choice, giving everyday athletes more ways to make Nike their own.
body_markdown:
The future of Nike Sportswear has arrived.


Nike’s classics are the iconic foundation of Sportswear, but the brand’s next era is about building on their strengths and innovating styles that are entirely new.


Local insights and product creation are bringing the brand closer to the communities shaping sport and culture. New design energy is providing a halo platform for reimagining familiar and beloved classics. And a growing pipeline of footwear and apparel innovation is giving Nike the opportunity to create the Sportswear products of tomorrow.


Project Ride, Nike Morpho X and the Nike Therma-FIT A.I.R. Jacket are three examples of that[innovation pipeline](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nike-inc-unveils-the-next-generation-of-innovation-across-performance-sports-and-sportswear) coming to life, delivering structured comfort for life in motion; a versatile combination of all-day comfort and style; and personalized, adaptable warmth for changing conditions.


Together, they represent Nike Sportswear’s ambition for what comes next: a foundational business of sport-inspired icons and Sportswear-specific innovations, expressions and experiences that connect the brand to the next generation.


“Our classics are the foundation of Nike Sportswear, but the future can’t be built on classics alone,” says Sebastien Mermet, VP, Creative Director, Nike Sportswear. “Through local creation, reimagining our vault, building new innovations like Project Ride and Nike Morpho X, and scaling platforms like Therma-FIT A.I.R., we’re finding new ways to evolve what athletes already love while creating something new for the next generation. That’s how we continue to break through.”


**Project Ride: Structured Comfort for Life in Motion**


Project Ride starts with a growing athlete need for all-day comfort, utility and style. Designed around how athletes actually move through the city, Project Ride addresses the realities of high daily step counts, changing terrain and constant stop-and-go movement.


While footwear has increasingly prioritized softer cushioning, softness alone doesn't address every demand of a full day in motion. Project Ride combines ultra-soft cushioning with an external structural cage to create structured comfort that balances softness underfoot with critical support and stability.


The shoe’s bold new design language also reinterprets[one of Nike’s most recognizable innovations](https://www.nike.com/a/never-done-breaking-the-mold-the-waffle-mindset) , using waffle geometry in a new way to create a fresh expression that’s designed for today and is instantly recognizable as Nike.


“Newness isn’t about being new for the sake of it,” says Mermet. “Project Ride starts with a real athlete need and gives us a new Nike solution for life in motion, taking classic Nike Waffle design language and giving it a new job for today’s city athlete.”


**Nike Morpho X: All-Day Comfort Meets All-Day Style**


Powered by[Nike’s latest SkyX foam technology](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nike-swooshfly-makes-race-day-feel-more-possible) , Nike Morpho X brings[performance innovation](https://about.nike.com/en/magazine/how-nike-designed-swooshfly-an-invitation-the-marathon-starting-line) into a new Sportswear shoe designed for athletes balancing every part of their day.


A lightweight ripstop upper, supportive internal structure and[exceptional cushioning](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/collections/explainer-how-nike-s-innovative-foams-deliver-performance-and-comfort) come together in a design intended to work across different fits, settings and moments.


Rather than simply borrowing the aesthetic of performance running, Nike Morpho X starts with the underlying innovation and tunes the experience for everyday life.


“Nike Morpho X shows how sport innovation can fuel what’s next for Sportswear,” says Mermet. “The performance technology gives us the benefit, and Sportswear gives it a new expression.”


**Therma-FIT A.I.R. Jacket: Personalized Warmth, Powered by Air**


The Therma-FIT A.I.R. Jacket takes an advanced apparel innovation first expressed through[the Therma-FIT Air Milano Jacket](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nike-therma-fit-air-milano-jacket-official-images) and scales its athlete benefit into a new Sportswear silhouette.


Using the inflatable baffles at the center of Nike’s Adapt. Inflate. Regulate. platform, athletes can add or release air as conditions and activity levels change, transforming static insulation into adaptable comfort.


It’s a new expression of what Air can mean at Nike:[an advanced athlete benefit](https://about.nike.com/en/magazine/behind-the-scenes-of-creating-arianna-fontana-s-one-of-one-performance-jacket) translated into an intuitive, everyday athlete experience.


“We wanted the jacket to feel unmistakably Nike Sportswear, even without relying on a Swoosh,” says Mermet. “Its form, function and attitude tells you where it came from.”


Nike Morpho X and the Therma-FIT A.I.R. Jacket will debut in 2027, and Project Ride in 2028, with more details to follow in the seasons to come.
